policy.statement: Static parsing, formatting, typing and record validation may run on a workstation. Acceptance tests are owned by CI and are not run locally.
policy.reason: A local run proves what one machine did. Acceptance evidence has to be attributable and re-readable by someone who was not present, which is a property of the CI run and not of the command.

commands.reason: Static lint. Reads source, changes nothing, needs no service.
Static typing of the control-plane boundaries.
Record validation. Parses checked-in files only.
This contract's own guard. Parses checked-in files only.
Profile and instruction validation. Reads the repository.
Programme matrix validation. Reads the repository; the pinned-dossier arm additionally reads a checkout CI supplies.
Conformance profile validation. CI reaches it through the composite action's launcher, which is the alias.
The acceptance suite, including every known-bad control. CI is the acceptance owner; a local pass is not evidence and must not be reported as any.

setup_commands.reason: Installs the pinned validators from requirements-dev.txt. Provisioning, not validation.
The inline extractor that reads the pinned dossier revision out of programmes/*.json so the next step can fetch it. Data extraction for a later step, not a check of its own.
